name: chembench-subset-2026-09-14
description: 100 expert-written single-answer multiple-choice chemistry questions, 13 from each of eight ChemBench categories (9 from toxicity_and_safety, which the 100-question trim cut). Only items whose target_scores name exactly one correct option are kept, because every other item type needs a different scorer. Sampled with a fixed seed (20260914) from a contiguous page per category, so the subset is reproducible from the fetch script. Ids that ChemBench repeats within a category are disambiguated with a `#n` suffix here, because the id is this corpus's key.
